name: Kisaragi Yui
source:
A pretty girl who Natsuo met in the neighborhood. For some reason, she only appears where cherry blossoms are blooming. She seems to be solid, she seems to be missing something, she seems to be calm, and she suddenly wakes up, and it is elusive.

[Translated from [url=https://kaitaishinnyo.wixsite.com/captain-myaosuke/ikiru-character?pgid=kmt92opw-0d0687c4-c2c2-4229-916d-13c026465156]official website[/url]]
